title: Street posters / Measure for Measure

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use a simple object-action image to focus attention because a passerby has only a brief encounter.
strategic_value: The large hand and pocket watch can give Measure for Measure a recognizable visual cue at street scale.
demonstration: The foreground sign combines a hand, watch and tall black title; Office Hour and a third campaign appear behind.
practical_value: Assess how a single image and condensed title hold up in a sidewalk sign.

content_islands.name: Primary panel
content_islands.spec: Place the hand and watch above and through the title on white.

content_islands.name: Context
content_islands.spec: Show the two receding signs beside the stone facade to preserve placement evidence.

reference_purposes.Expression: The foreground sign combines a hand, watch and tall black title; Office Hour and a third campaign appear behind.
reference_purposes.Application: The Measure for Measure campaign appears in a freestanding sidewalk display beside two other productions.
